title: Botulinum toxin injections
what: The doctor gives a few tiny injections into muscles with a thin needle. The muscles relax, and wrinkles soften.
why: To smooth expression lines; also for heavy sweating, teeth grinding, and other medical reasons.
duration: the procedure usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; the effect appears after 3 to 14 days and usually lasts 3 to 6 months
tell_doctor: Medicines, especially antibiotics and blood thinners
If you had these injections before, and how it went

prepare.title: A few days before
prepare.text: Tell your doctor about all your medicines. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will decide.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: You are usually advised not to drink alcohol the day before and on the day.

steps: The doctor asks about your health and the result you want
You are asked to frown and smile, so the doctor can see the muscles
The skin is cleaned with antiseptic
A few tiny injections are given with a thin needle
The spots are not rubbed. Sometimes something cold is applied
feel: The injections are quick, like a mosquito bite
Small bumps at the injection spots go away in 15 to 30 minutes
Sometimes a mild headache or a small bruise
after: For 4 hours, do not lie down or bend over a lot
On the day, do not massage your face or rub the injection spots
For 1 to 2 days, no saunas, steam rooms, or hard workouts
A follow-up visit after 2 weeks, if your doctor booked one
red_flags: A drooping eyelid or eyebrow, or double vision
Trouble swallowing, speaking, or breathing: call emergency services right away

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Usually after 3 to 7 days, with the full effect by two weeks.
With the right dose, you keep your expressions. The wrinkles are just softer. Tell your doctor what result you want.

reminders.text: Injection procedure tomorrow. Skip alcohol and come without makeup.
